prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select a friend to preview their voice and personality traits.", "Choose Your Pet's Voice & Sounds", "Listen to how your desktop pet sounds when calling for attention or playing.", "Preview Voice Sample"]
1: ["If your pet does not appear automatically, check your system tray or press Alt+P."]
2: ["Signing into your primary account safely restores all your existing pets and desktop preferences."]
3: ["Your Pet Is Ready!", "Click below to summon your pet directly to the center of your screen.", "Summon Pet Now", "Desktop Placement Test", "Your pet is now active! Drag your pet anywhere on your screen."]
4: ["Custom Pet Photo Creator", "Choose Reference Photo", "Style Rendering Preview"]
5: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "See Your Companion in Action", "Your pet wanders across desktop windows, reacts to your mouse, and keeps you company."]
6: ["Instant Cloud Sign-In", "Connect your account in seconds to save your pet's memory and settings securely."]
7: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Pet", "Rendering your pet's animations. We'll notify you the instant your pet lands on your desktop!"]
8: ["Choose 'Preset Pet' for a quick 10-second setup, or 'Custom Pet' to generate from a photo."]
9: ["Your Pet Is On Your Screen!", "Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls, talk, or minimize to system tray.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to center your pet on screen."]
